subject: Requesting executive sign-off: one-off >20% Hosted API concession for Zephyr Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-08-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API proposal and SOW (Zephyr Health)

John — attaching the SOW and our initial Hosted API pricing for the pilot. Highlights:
- 250M input tokens/month over 12 months
- Standard enterprise list price shown in attached pricing-model.xlsx
- Suggested pilot discount: 15% (intro pricing)

We believe this aligns with the workload profile you shared and keeps unit economics intact. If you need an updated ARR/commit bucket to match procurement terms, let us know and we can produce a committed-rate proposal.

Attachments: Zephyr_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW, 4 pages), pricing-model.xlsx (breakdown)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: John Doe <john.doe@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@zephyrhealth.com
Date: 2028-08-19T11:02:43-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API proposal and SOW (Zephyr Health)

Ben — thanks for the docs. The team reviewed and we need deeper concessioning to hit our internal targets. Specifically:
- We are asking for a 35% discount off list for the first 12 months (we can commit to a 12-month term and provide a letter of intent)
- We also need an explicit SLA/latency target for the pilot

Can you escalate? Procurement says this will need executive approval.

—John
John Doe, Head of Data Platforms
Zephyr Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-08-19T12:29:10-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Hosted API proposal and SOW (Zephyr Health)

Folks — forwarding Zephyr's ask. They pushed to 35% and want an exec sign-off. Quick context:
- Strategic account in the health vertical; strong reference potential (regional provider network)
- Typical LTV expectation is high if pilot converts; pilot expected to grow tokens aggressively after Q2
- Current modeled impact with our pricing-model.xlsx shows ~28% maximum sustainable one-time concession without dragging unit economics below acceptable thresholds (assuming 12mo commit)

Can Stephanie please own the formal escalation and recommend a counter? If we push straight to 35% we lose margin; if we hold firm we risk losing the deal.

Ben
Account Executive
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-20T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Request: executive approval for exceptional Hosted API concession (Zephyr Health) — recommended 28%

Rishi / Marissa —

Summary: Zephyr Health (HS-12345) asked for 35% off list for a 12-month pilot. Ben's model shows we can tolerate a one-off concession of up to ~28% if we secure a 12-month committed spend and the following commercial guards:
- Commitment: 12 months, minimum billed seat/tokens equal to the pilot bucket in the attached pricing-model.xlsx
- Ramp clause: guaranteed floor for first 3 months; after month 3, consumption-based billing with monthly true-ups
- Early termination fee: pro-rated remainder of concession (to prevent churn-exploit)
- SLA: include our standard Hosted API SLA; for pilot we’ll commit to a 99.5% availability target and the latency objective listed in the SOW appendix (subject to monitoring)

Why 28% (not 35%): preserves ~5-7% margin buffer vs Ben's worst-case model and keeps the deal within acceptable unit economics while giving Zephyr a meaningful commercial uplift. We gain a strategic reference in health and potential expansion via their partner network.

Requested action:
- Approve an exceptional 28% off list price for the first 12 months, conditioned on the contract guards above
- If approved, I will draft the formal concession memo for Legal + Finance and send a redlined SOW back to Zephyr (and copy Deal Desk)

Attachments referenced: pricing-model.xlsx, Zephyr_SOW_v2.pdf
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.redwoodinference.com/deal/HS-12345

Please reply with Approve / Decline / Need more info.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Deal Desk Specialist | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-21T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: executive approval for exceptional Hosted API concession (Zephyr Health) — recommended 28%

Approve.

Conditions I want codified before we finalize:
1) 12-month minimum committed spend documented in Section 3 of the SOW
2) Concession applied only to Hosted API usage line items; other services bill at standard rates
3) Early termination fee equal to the unamortized portion of the concession (Finance to calculate)
4) Quarterly business review (QBR) cadence with Zephyr for the first 12 months

Stephanie — proceed with drafting the concession memo and update the SOW; loop Legal and Finance for the early termination language and confirm SLA appendix. Ben — once the redline is ready, set expectation with John that this is a one-time executive concession tied to commit.

Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
